Nothing has cleared yet. The leaderboard above still reports how far short every route falls — that shortfall is the measurement.
Paper mode. No private key is loaded and no transaction is ever signed. Live execution needs mode = "live" in config.toml and CRYPTOBOT_ALLOW_LIVE=1, and is deliberately not implemented.
Every price here is decoded from mainnet accounts. Concentrated-liquidity pools are quoted through their virtual reserves and refuse to price a trade larger than the current tick can hold, so a route's depth is a real limit rather than an extrapolation.
Decoders are audited against an independent router with cb-bot --verify, which flags any pool claiming an output nobody else can route. That check exists because a missing fee field once put one pool 52 bps off its true price and this page reported the difference as a standing arbitrage for four hours. Opportunities counts distinct episodes, not detections: a gap that stands still is re-seen every sweep, and counting each sighting as a trade inflates the total by orders of magnitude.
